# Beacon CRM rollout

**As of:** 13 October 2026  
**Overall status:** Amber

## Status by dimension

| Dimension | Status | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Schedule | Amber | Largest slip: non-critical milestone 'Training guides', 14 days (2 milestones slipped in total). |
| Budget | Unknown | No planned budget figure in the notes. |
| Scope | Amber | 1 change request pending approval. |
| Risk | Green | 2 open items, none high-impact. |

## Executive summary

Beacon CRM rollout is amber overall due to schedule and scope risks. The pilot completed successfully on 2 October with 41 users and NPS of +32, but training guides have slipped 14 days to 30 October. Data migration testing is underway with new match rules being rerun Thursday to address ~2% deduplication failures. Budget figures are not covered in the current notes. The team needs steering committee decision on CR-14 email plugin integration and an executive all-hands announcement of the go-live date by 2 November.

## Accomplishments this period

- Pilot completed on 2 October with 41 pilot users and NPS of +32
- Data migration test load of legacy records completed with ~2% deduplication failures
- Training guides drafted

## Next steps

- Rerun data migration with new match rules on Thursday
- Cutover runbook draft by 23 October
- Dress rehearsal on 7 November
- Obtain updated budget numbers from finance

## Top risks and issues

- **Data migration deduplication: ~2% of legacy records failed deduplication in test load** (medium impact)  
  Owner: Priya Raman · Mitigation: Rerunning with new match rules on Thursday
- **SSO configuration for contractor accounts** (low impact)  
  Owner: Priya Raman · Mitigation: not stated

## Decisions and asks for leadership

- Steering committee decision on CR-14 email plugin integration scope change
- Executive all-hands announcement of go-live date to be sent by 2 November

## Gaps in the notes

- No budget figures provided
